product.title: 2-Hour Off-Road Razor Ridge Run Tour in the Desert

description.text: Ride Polaris RZR side-by-sides through Carson Valley and the Pine Nut Mountains on a guided off-road tour. Scenic stops showcase high-desert views near Lake Tahoe with helmets, bandanas, and bottled water included for beginner and intermediate riders.

highlights: Guided off-road Razor tour through Carson Valley
Scenic ridge runs in the Pine Nut Mountain Range
Suited to beginner and intermediate riders
Helmet, bandana, and bottled water included
Complimentary shuttle from select South Shore hotels

start.description: Meet at the Lake Tahoe Adventures base with complimentary shuttle pickup available from select South Shore hotels.

end.description: Return to the meeting point or hotel shuttle drop-off after the ride.

product.itinerarySummary: Ride Polaris RZR side-by-sides through Carson Valley and the Pine Nut Mountains on a guided off-road tour.

itineraryItems.title: Lake Tahoe Adventures Base
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide, receive safety briefing, and board the Polaris RZR for the ridge run.

itineraryItems.title: Carson Valley
itineraryItems.description: Follow your guide across desert washes, rocky hills, and sagebrush flats with photo stops.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the 2-Hour Off-Road Razor Ridge Run Tour in the Desert?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 to 4 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at Lake Tahoe?
faqs.answer: Meet at the Lake Tahoe Adventures base with complimentary shuttle pickup available from select South Shore hotels.
